'?' : '') + qs + hash;\n    } else {\n      // If URL was passed in, parse params from URL string, otherwise parse\n      // params from window.location.href.\n      result = get_func(url !== undefined ? url : location.href);\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n  ;\n  jq_param[str_querystring] = curry(jq_param_sub, 0, get_querystring);\n  jq_param[str_fragment] = jq_param_fragment = curry(jq_param_sub, 1, get_fragment);\n\n  // Method: jQuery.param.sorted\n  //\n  // Returns a params string equivalent to that returned by the internal\n  // jQuery.param method, but sorted, which makes it suitable for use as a\n  // cache key.\n  //\n  // For example, in most browsers jQuery.param({z:1,a:2}) returns \"z=1&a=2\"\n  // and jQuery.param({a:2,z:1}) returns \"a=2&z=1\". Even though both the\n  // objects being serialized and the resulting params strings are equivalent,\n  // if these params strings were set into the location.hash fragment\n  // sequentially, the hashchange event would be triggered unnecessarily, since\n  // the strings are different (even though the data described by them is the\n  // same). By sorting the params string, unecessary hashchange event triggering\n  // can be avoided.\n  //\n  // Usage:\n  //\n  // > jQuery.param.sorted( obj [, traditional ] );\n  //\n  // Arguments:\n  //\n  //  obj - (Object) An object to be serialized.\n  //  traditional - (Boolean) Params deep/shallow serialization mode. This option only applies to serialized data\n  // object fragments, and not set-as-string fragments. Does not affect the\n  // query string. That being said, be careful to not\n  // unescape characters that are used as delimiters or serve a special\n  // purpose, such as the \"#?&=+\" (octothorpe, question mark, ampersand,\n  // equals, plus) characters.\n  //\n  // Usage:\n  //\n  // > jQuery.param.fragment.noEscape( [ chars ] );\n  //\n  // Arguments:\n  //\n  //  chars - (String) The characters to not escape in the fragment. +val // number\n          : val === 'undefined' ? undefined // undefined\n          : coerce_types[val] !== undefined ? coerce_types[val] // true, false, null\n          : val; // string\n        }\n        if (keys_last) {\n          // Complex key, build deep object structure based on a few rules:\n          // * The 'cur' pointer starts at the object top-level.\n          // * [] = array push (n is set to array length), [n] = array if n is\n          //   numeric, otherwise object.\n          // * If at the last keys part, set the value.\n          // * For each keys part, if the current level is undefined create an\n          //   object or array based on the type of the next keys part.\n          // * Move the 'cur' pointer to the next level.\n          // * Rinse & repeat.\n          for (; i <= keys_last; i++) {\n            key = keys[i] === '' ? cur.length : keys[i];\n            cur = cur[key] = i < keys_last ? cur[key] || (keys[i + 1] && isNaN(keys[i + 1]) ? {} : []) : val;\n          }\n        } else {\n          // Simple key, even simpler rules, since only scalars and shallow\n          // arrays are allowed.\n\n          if ($.isArray(obj[key])) {\n            // val is already an array, so push on the next value.\n            obj[key].push(val);\n          } else if (obj[key] !== undefined) {\n            // val isn't an array, but since a second value has been specified,\n            // convert val into an array.\n            obj[key] = [obj[key], val];\n          } else {\n            // val is a scalar.\n            obj[key] = val;\n          }\n        }\n      } else if (key) {\n        // No value was defined, so set something meaningful.\n        obj[key] = coerce ? undefined : '';\n      }\n    });\n    return obj;\n  };\n\n  // Method: jQuery.deparam.querystring\n  //\n  // Parse the query string from a URL or the current window.location.href,\n  // deserializing it into an object, optionally coercing numbers, booleans,\n  // null and undefined values.\n  //\n  // Usage:\n  //\n  // > jQuery.deparam.querystring( [ url ] [, coerce ] );\n  //\n  // Arguments:\n  //\n  //  url - (String) An optional params string or URL containing query string\n  //    params to be parsed. Defaults to false if omitted.\n  //\n  // Returns:\n  //\n  //  (Object) An object representing the deserialized params string.\n\n  function jq_deparam_sub(is_fragment, url_or_params, coerce) {\n    if (url_or_params === undefined || typeof url_or_params === 'boolean') {\n      // url_or_params not specified.\n      coerce = url_or_params;\n      url_or_params = jq_param[is_fragment ? str_fragment : str_querystring]();\n    } else {\n      url_or_params = is_string(url_or_params) ? url_or_params.replace(is_fragment ? re_params_fragment : re_params_querystring, '') : url_or_params;\n    }\n    return jq_deparam(url_or_params, coerce);\n  }\n  ;\n  jq_deparam[str_querystring] = curry(jq_deparam_sub, 0);\n  jq_deparam[str_fragment] = jq_deparam_fragment = curry(jq_deparam_sub, 1);\n\n  // Section: Element manipulation\n  //\n  // Method: jQuery.elemUrlAttr\n  //\n  // Get the internal \"Default URL attribute per tag\" list, or augment the list\n  // with additional tag-attribute pairs, in case the defaults are insufficient.\n  //\n  // In the <jQuery.fn.querystring> and <jQuery.fn.fragment> methods, this list\n  // is used to determine which attribute contains the URL to be modified, if\n  // an \"attr\" param is not specified.\n  //\n  // Default Tag-Attribute List:\n  //\n  //  a      - '?' : '') + qs + hash;\n    } else {\n      // If URL was passed in, parse params from URL string, otherwise parse\n      // params from window.location.href.\n      result = get_func(url !== undefined ? url : location.href);\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n  ;\n  jq_param[str_querystring] = curry(jq_param_sub, 0, get_querystring);\n  jq_param[str_fragment] = jq_param_fragment = curry(jq_param_sub, 1, get_fragment);\n\n  // Method: jQuery.param.sorted\n  //\n  // Returns a params string equivalent to that returned by the internal\n  // jQuery.param method, but sorted, which makes it suitable for use as a\n  // cache key.\n  //\n  // For example, in most browsers jQuery.param({z:1,a:2}) returns \"z=1&a=2\"\n  // and jQuery.param({a:2,z:1}) returns \"a=2&z=1\". Even though both the\n  // objects being serialized and the resulting params strings are equivalent,\n  // if these params strings were set into the location.hash fragment\n  // sequentially, the hashchange event would be triggered unnecessarily, since\n  // the strings are different (even though the data described by them is the\n  // same). By sorting the params string, unecessary hashchange event triggering\n  // can be avoided.\n  //\n  // Usage:\n  //\n  // > jQuery.param.sorted( obj [, traditional ] );\n  //\n  // Arguments:\n  //\n  //  obj - (Object) An object to be serialized.\n  //  traditional - (Boolean) Params deep/shallow serialization mode. This option only applies to serialized data\n  // object fragments, and not set-as-string fragments. Does not affect the\n  // query string. That being said, be careful to not\n  // unescape characters that are used as delimiters or serve a special\n  // purpose, such as the \"#?&=+\" (octothorpe, question mark, ampersand,\n  // equals, plus) characters.\n  //\n  // Usage:\n  //\n  // > jQuery.param.fragment.noEscape( [ chars ] );\n  //\n  // Arguments:\n  //\n  //  chars - (String) The characters to not escape in the fragment. +val // number\n          : val === 'undefined' ? undefined // undefined\n          : coerce_types[val] !== undefined ? coerce_types[val] // true, false, null\n          : val; // string\n        }\n        if (keys_last) {\n          // Complex key, build deep object structure based on a few rules:\n          // * The 'cur' pointer starts at the object top-level.\n          // * [] = array push (n is set to array length), [n] = array if n is\n          //   numeric, otherwise object.\n          // * If at the last keys part, set the value.\n          // * For each keys part, if the current level is undefined create an\n          //   object or array based on the type of the next keys part.\n          // * Move the 'cur' pointer to the next level.\n          // * Rinse & repeat.\n          for (; i <= keys_last; i++) {\n            key = keys[i] === '' ? cur.length : keys[i];\n            cur = cur[key] = i < keys_last ? cur[key] || (keys[i + 1] && isNaN(keys[i + 1]) ? {} : []) : val;\n          }\n        } else {\n          // Simple key, even simpler rules, since only scalars and shallow\n          // arrays are allowed.\n\n          if ($.isArray(obj[key])) {\n            // val is already an array, so push on the next value.\n            obj[key].push(val);\n          } else if (obj[key] !== undefined) {\n            // val isn't an array, but since a second value has been specified,\n            // convert val into an array.\n            obj[key] = [obj[key], val];\n          } else {\n            // val is a scalar.\n            obj[key] = val;\n          }\n        }\n      } else if (key) {\n        // No value was defined, so set something meaningful.\n        obj[key] = coerce ? undefined : '';\n      }\n    });\n    return obj;\n  };\n\n  // Method: jQuery.deparam.querystring\n  //\n  // Parse the query string from a URL or the current window.location.href,\n  // deserializing it into an object, optionally coercing numbers, booleans,\n  // null and undefined values.\n  //\n  // Usage:\n  //\n  // > jQuery.deparam.querystring( [ url ] [, coerce ] );\n  //\n  // Arguments:\n  //\n  //  url - (String) An optional params string or URL containing query string\n  //    params to be parsed. Defaults to false if omitted.\n  //\n  // Returns:\n  //\n  //  (Object) An object representing the deserialized params string.\n\n  function jq_deparam_sub(is_fragment, url_or_params, coerce) {\n    if (url_or_params === undefined || typeof url_or_params === 'boolean') {\n      // url_or_params not specified.\n      coerce = url_or_params;\n      url_or_params = jq_param[is_fragment ? str_fragment : str_querystring]();\n    } else {\n      url_or_params = is_string(url_or_params) ? url_or_params.replace(is_fragment ? re_params_fragment : re_params_querystring, '') : url_or_params;\n    }\n    return jq_deparam(url_or_params, coerce);\n  }\n  ;\n  jq_deparam[str_querystring] = curry(jq_deparam_sub, 0);\n  jq_deparam[str_fragment] = jq_deparam_fragment = curry(jq_deparam_sub, 1);\n\n  // Section: Element manipulation\n  //\n  // Method: jQuery.elemUrlAttr\n  //\n  // Get the internal \"Default URL attribute per tag\" list, or augment the list\n  // with additional tag-attribute pairs, in case the defaults are insufficient.\n  //\n  // In the <jQuery.fn.querystring> and <jQuery.fn.fragment> methods, this list\n  // is used to determine which attribute contains the URL to be modified, if\n  // an \"attr\" param is not specified.\n  //\n  // Default Tag-Attribute List:\n  //\n  //  a      - 'enable' : 'disable');\n        };\n        this.update = function () {};\n      }\n    },\n    _Color = function Color() {\n      var spaces = {\n          rgb: {\n            r: 0,\n            g: 0,\n            b: 0\n          },\n          hsv: {\n            h: 0,\n            s: 0,\n            v: 0\n          },\n          hsl: {\n            h: 0,\n            s: 0,\n            l: 0\n          },\n          lab: {\n            l: 0,\n            a: 0,\n            b: 0\n          },\n          cmyk: {\n            c: 0,\n            m: 0,\n            y: 0,\n            k: 1\n          }\n        },\n        a = 1,\n        args = arguments,\n        _clip = function _clip(v) {\n          if (isNaN(v) || v === null) {\n            return 0;\n          }\n          if (typeof v == 'string') {\n            v = parseInt(v, 10);\n          }\n          return Math.max(0, Math.min(v, 1));\n        },\n        _hexify = function _hexify(number) {\n          var digits = '0123456789abcdef',\n            lsd = number % 16,\n            msd = (number - lsd) / 16,\n            hexified = digits.charAt(msd) + digits.charAt(lsd);\n          return hexified;\n        },\n        _rgb_to_xyz = function _rgb_to_xyz(rgb) {\n          var r = rgb.r > 0.04045 ? Math.pow((rgb.r + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4) : rgb.r / 12.92,\n            g = rgb.g > 0.04045 ? Math.pow((rgb.g + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4) : rgb.g / 12.92,\n            b = rgb.b > 0.04045 ? Math.pow((rgb.b + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4) : rgb.b / 12.92;\n          return {\n            x: r * 0.4124 + g * 0.3576 + b * 0.1805,\n            y: r * 0.2126 + g * 0.7152 + b * 0.0722,\n            z: r * 0.0193 + g * 0.1192 + b * 0.9505\n          };\n        },\n        _xyz_to_rgb = function _xyz_to_rgb(xyz) {\n          var rgb = {\n            r: xyz.x * 3.2406 + xyz.y * -1.5372 + xyz.z * -0.4986,\n            g: xyz.x * -0.9689 + xyz.y * 1.8758 + xyz.z * 0.0415,\n            b: xyz.x * 0.0557 + xyz.y * -0.2040 + xyz.z * 1.0570\n          };\n          rgb.r = rgb.r > 0.0031308 ? == KEYS.BACKSPACE) {\n          this._handleClear(evt);\n        }\n      };\n      AllowClear.prototype.update = function (decorated, data) {\n        decorated.call(this, data);\n        if (this.$selection.find('.select2-selection__placeholder').length > 0 || data.length === 0) {\n          return;\n        }\n        var $remove = $('<span class=\"select2-selection__clear\">' + the values are techIds.\n  $.each(endpoints, function () {\n    var $elem = $techtree.find(\".tech\" + this.toString());\n    newTree.addEndpoint($elem);\n    var elemLeft = Math.floor($elem.find('a').offset().left);\n    var elemTop = Math.floor($elem.find('a').offset().top);\n    coordinates[this] = [elemLeft, elemTop];\n  });\n  var changedSomething;\n  do {\n    // for every connection:\n    // check if the source is below the target on the screen. if not, move the source downwards one row\n    changedSomething = false;\n    $.each(connections, function () {\n      var $source = $techtree.find(\".tech\" + this.source + \" a\");\n      var $target = $techtree.find(\".tech\" + this.target + \" a\");\n      if ($source.offset().top >= $target.offset().top - 10 && $source.offset().top <= $target.offset().top + 10) {\n        $source.parent().css('margin-top', parseInt($source.parent().css('margin-top').replace(/px/, '')) + rowHeight);\n\n        // we just moved a tech downwards... we have to adjust all corresponding coordinates\n        // the surrounding div with class depth* is the second parent\n        $source.parent().parent().find('a[data-tech-id]').each(function () {\n          coordinates[$(this).attr('data-tech-id')][1] += rowHeight; // 1 == top\n          //console.log(\"RESET \"+$(this).attr('data-tech-id') + \" \"+(coordinates[$(this).attr('data-tech-id')][1]));\n        });\n        changedSomething = true;\n      }\n    });\n  } while (changedSomething);\n\n  // columns and rows: these 2 arrays will contain all different left- and top-values of the endpoint coordinates\n  var columns = [];\n  var rows = [];\n  for (var elem in coordinates) {\n    if (columns.indexOf(coordinates[elem][0]) == -1) {\n      columns.push(coordinates[elem][0]);\n    }\n    if (rows.indexOf(coordinates[elem][1]) == -1) {\n      rows.push(coordinates[elem][1]);\n    }\n  }\n  columns.sort(function (a, b) {\n    return a > b ? 1 : -1;\n  });\n  rows.sort(function (a, b) {\n    return a > b ? 1 : -1;\n  });\n  // now the 2 arrays contain a numeric sorted list\n\n  // translated: an array containing the same keys as the coordinates-array, but the values aren't pixels anymore.\n  // they are the numbers of the row/column containing that endpoint\n  // with this In 'fragment' mode, #\n      // is always added.\n      result = matches[1] + (is_fragment ? fragment_prefix : qs || !matches[1] ? '?' : '') + qs + hash;\n    } else {\n      // If URL was passed in, parse params from URL string, otherwise parse\n      // params from window.location.href.\n      result = get_func(url !== undefined ? url : location.href);\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n  ;\n  jq_param[str_querystring] = curry(jq_param_sub, 0, get_querystring);\n  jq_param[str_fragment] = jq_param_fragment = curry(jq_param_sub, 1, get_fragment);\n\n  // Method: jQuery.param.sorted\n  //\n  // Returns a params string equivalent to that returned by the internal\n  // jQuery.param method, but sorted, which makes it suitable for use as a\n  // cache key.\n  //\n  // For example, in most browsers jQuery.param({z:1,a:2}) returns \"z=1&a=2\"\n  // and jQuery.param({a:2,z:1}) returns \"a=2&z=1\". +val // number\n          : val === 'undefined' ? undefined // undefined\n          : coerce_types[val] !== undefined ? coerce_types[val] // true, false, null\n          : val; // string\n        }\n        if (keys_last) {\n          // Complex key, build deep object structure based on a few rules:\n          // * The 'cur' pointer starts at the object top-level.\n          // * [] = array push (n is set to array length), [n] = array if n is\n          //   numeric, otherwise object.\n          // * If at the last keys part, set the value.\n          // * For each keys part, if the current level is undefined create an\n          //   object or array based on the type of the next keys part.\n          // * Move the 'cur' pointer to the next level.\n          // * Rinse & repeat.\n          for (; i <= keys_last; i++) {\n            key = keys[i] === '' ? cur.length : keys[i];\n            cur = cur[key] = i < keys_last ? cur[key] || (keys[i + 1] && isNaN(keys[i + 1]) ? {} : []) : val;\n          }\n        } else {\n          // Simple key, even simpler rules, since only scalars and shallow\n          // arrays are allowed.\n\n          if ($.isArray(obj[key])) {\n            // val is already an array, so push on the next value.\n            obj[key].push(val);\n          } else if (obj[key] !== undefined) {\n            // val isn't an array, but since a second value has been specified,\n            // convert val into an array.\n            obj[key] = [obj[key], val];\n          } else {\n            // val is a scalar.\n            obj[key] = val;\n          }\n        }\n      } else if (key) {\n        // No value was defined, so set something meaningful.\n        obj[key] = coerce ? undefined : '';\n      }\n    });\n    return obj;\n  };\n\n  // Method: jQuery.deparam.querystring\n  //\n  // Parse the query string from a URL or the current window.location.href,\n  // deserializing it into an object, optionally coercing numbers, booleans,\n  // null and undefined values.\n  //\n  // Usage:\n  //\n  // > jQuery.deparam.querystring( [ url ] [, coerce ] );\n  //\n  // Arguments:\n  //\n  //  url - (String) An optional params string or URL containing query string\n  //    params to be parsed. typeof a.id !== 'undefined') {\n          a = a.id;\n        }\n        if (_typeof(b) === 'object' && typeof b.id !== 'undefined') {\n          b = b.id;\n        }\n        if (typeof a === 'number' (order === \"descending\") {\n            return -1;\n          }\n          return 1;\n        }\n        if (typeof a === 'string' && typeof b === 'string') {\n          if (order === b.split(':').map(function (num) {\n              if (num.length === 1) {\n                _stringifiedCoords += \"0\".concat(num);\n              } else {\n                _stringifiedCoords += num;\n              }\n            });\n            b = parseInt(_stringifiedCoords);\n          }\n        }\n        return compareData(a, b, order);\n      });\n    } catch (e) {\n      return;\n    }\n {\n      deltaSystem = diffSystem;\n    }\n    deltaSystem = Math.max(deltaSystem - emptySystems - inactiveSystems, 1);\n    return deltaSystem * 5 * 19 + 2700;\n  } else if (diffPlanet != 0) {\n this.getFleetSpeedFaktor(mission)), 1);\n};\nFleetHelper.prototype.calcConsumption = function (ships, distance, speedPercent, holdingTime, mission) {\n  mission = mission || this.MISSION_NONE;\n  var that = this;\n  var consumption = 0;\n  var holdingCosts = 0;\n  var shipIds = ships.map(function (ship) {\n    return ship.id;\n  });\n  var maxSpeed = this.getMaxSpeed(shipIds);\n  if (mission === this.MISSION_DESTROY) {\n    maxSpeed = Math.min(maxSpeed, this.SPEED_FLEET_MOON_DESTRUCTION);\n  }\n  var duration = this.calcDuration(distance, maxSpeed, speedPercent, mission);\n  var speedValue = ship.number * distance / 35000 * (shipSpeedValue / 10 + 1) * (shipSpeedValue / 10 + 1), 1);\n    }\n  });\n  consumption = Math.round(consumption);\n  consumption += holdingTime > 0 ?
